decision: Maintainer 2026-10-31 'Research A Immediate STOP and Token-Matched Data Completion': 「本次指令允许在现有 Research A 和项目累计硬上限内开展补数，但旧的冻结科学身份不能被当成新版授权使用。必须先完成合法的设计变更、预算核算及新的适用授权，所有既有实际支出必须计入累计账本，不得重置额度。」 and 2026-10-31 'Research A STOP、Token-Matched 数据补齐及 D4 Full Search 方案审查': 「可以在适用的合法授权范围内继续补充 Teacher 数据；如果旧冻结授权不能覆盖新设计，必须先处理新的授权身份，不能直接沿用旧的科学执行权限。不得自动提高预算或改用 A100。」
_ceiling: Research A's cumulative $142.19 minus everything Research A v1 spent ($42.8017 in six sessions' closeouts, $3.50 storage): the phase cap is not reset, raised or duplicated
_per_session: the v1 teacher envelope's per-session cap, unchanged
_gpus: the L40S only, at most one GPU on one pod; no A100

network_volume.expansion: none: the supplement's shards (about 1 GB) fit

scope: the supplementary teacher generation of Research A v2 (configs/stages/stage-2/teacher_modes/token_matched_design.json, its preregistration and supplement protocol, order_v2) through scripts/stages/stage-2/teacher_modes/token_matched_phase.py --kind supplement; the dev box's $0 admission after it
retries: ordinary pre-generation engineering failures are repaired and rerun as new runs with new one-use artifacts inside this one cumulative envelope (P12.1); sealed records are never regenerated; a deterministic failure is never retried unchanged
never: a D4 full search, a calibration generation, an initialization, a student recovery or a student evaluation (proposals awaiting the maintainer's review)
an A100 or any card other than the L40S; a budget increase
Research A v1's frozen identity or grant as authority for any of this
authorizes: one-use supplement artifacts inside the ceiling, each priced at the live rate
